contexts.text: If he would exercise command otherwise, he was a rebel... HH 407. SE 3872.
For they are a house of rebellion () = those who can understand, etc., and will not.
In the third year they rebelled () = the beginning of temptations in (His) childhood.

What to rebel signifies, may be evident when it is predicated of the evils, or of the evil Spirits, with man, when they have been subjugated, or are serving, and begin to rise up and infest. Evils, or evil Spirits, rebel, in proportion as a man who wants to be in goods and truths, confirms with himself any evils and falsities; or in proportion as cupidities and Falsities insinuate themselves into his goods and truths...
Because of evils, which are the house of rebellion ().
Therefore, when man is being reformed, and begins to become spiritual... the Natural rebels...
a. 4. If man had a perception (of this influx) he would rebel...
Those who rebel against Thee (). To rebel is said when there are defection and transgression.
When Satan became a rebel... HH 544.
Rebellious commotions in Hell are continual, because everyone wants to be greatest.
There breathed on the rebels the delight of marriage.
(Comparison with) an army of robbers or rebels...
He who mixes himself up with rebels, at last scruples not to do violence to anyone.
There was as it were a rebellion (in the Heaven of Spirits).
Although the letter be dead and a rebel like Absalom...
They wanted to excite them to rebellion.
Those Spirits who were rebellious or seditious...
Thus it carried down all who had rebelled...
They stirred up a rebellion...
As they began to rebel against the Lord.
a. Those who had kept them strongly in rebellion...
Again and again they became rebellious.
As when a rebellion is made by a few.
To be against this (Divine truth) is signified by to rebel to the eyes of His glory (). AE 433:33.
Yet the Lord rules them, not like subjects of His Kingdom, but like rebels, by keeping them in bonds to prevent their doing evil to each other.
